ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram, what supplies the energy for the food web shown?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The picture is a food web, containing many animals and plant-based foods, such as black bear, white-tailed deer, red panda, bald eagle, chipmunk, dormouse, macaque, as well as berries, bamboo, fruit, acorns, etc. In the lower right corner there is a yellow icon labeled “sun”, and there are arrows from the sun pointing to plant-based food sources, such as fruit, bamboo, berries. Then reason: The energy of a food web usually comes from the sun; plants or producers use sunlight to produce energy and pass it to other organisms. Therefore, the energy source of this food web is the sun.
